senses.gloss:
तङ्क् तङ्क्, cl. 1. P. तङ्कति, ततङ्क,
तङ्कितुम्, to live in distress, be in poverty
or pain; to go (?); [cf. Hib. teicheamh, ‘a going,
passage;’ tochamhlaim, ‘I march;’ tochar, ‘a
causeway, pavement;’ toichim, ‘going, departing:’
Lith. tekù, ‘I run;’ tákas, ‘a path;’ tekûnas, ‘a
runner:’ Slav. takû, ‘I run.’]

1. तङ्क, अस्, m. grief produced by separation from a
beloved object; fear, terror; [cf. आ-तङ्क, तपस्-तङ्क.]

तङ्क 2. तङ्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (for टङ्क), an
axe, a stone-cutter's chisel.

तङ्ग् तङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. तङ्गति, &c., to go,
move; to stumble; to shake, tremble; [cf.
Hib. tagaidh, ‘advance;’ tigim, ‘I come, go.’]

तङ्गण तङ्गण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
in the upper part of the valley of the Sarayū.

तङ्गल्व तङ्गल्व, अस्, m., Ved., N. of an
evil spirit.
